messages:
Marta: Heads-up — I just rolled back a runtime config push (cfg_v2) after we saw a spike in p95 tail latency for low-priority routing groups. Rolling back now, but we should discuss safer rollout controls.
Alex: Ugh, saw the alert. Do you have the commit id / config snippet?
Marta: commit 9f3b2a, config snippet below. It toggled aggressive_routing: true for cohort=low which increased batching mismatch.
```
{
  "config_id": "cfg_v2",
  "changes": {
    "routing_policy": "aggressive",
    "cohorts": ["low"],
    "cache_ttl_ms": 0
  }
}
```
Marta: infra-bot shows the rollout events: apply started 2812345679, rollback started 2812345702
infra-bot: rollout_event: {type: "apply", id: "cfg_v2", user: "Marta", status: "partial_fail", affected_routes: 12}
Samir: Key takeaways: we need a) a dry-run/simulate mode that runs the config against recent traces, b) telemetry gates with explicit metric thresholds, and c) automatic fallback if gate breaches within X minutes.
Jess: Also console UX: when someone clicks "Apply" we should show an estimated impact preview (routes touched, delta on estimated cost, expected p95 change from past traces) and require a one-line reason + owner.
Alex: Agreed. For the API shape I'm thinking we add a telemetry_gate block to runtime config; example:
```
"telemetry_gate": {
  "metric": "inference.latency.p95",
  "window": "5m",
  "threshold_pct_increase": 15,
  "action_on_breach": "auto_rollback"
}
```
Alex: We can implement the gate by replaying a sample of recent traffic in a sandboxed runner and compare metrics before/after. If > threshold, mark candidate as blocked.
Samir: Implementation notes: sampling + deterministic replay will be expensive. We should support a cheaper dry-run mode that uses heuristics (sequence length distribution, cache hit rate delta) and a heavier replay for high-risk flags (e.g., routing, caching, batching).
Jess: Console idea: an "Impact Preview" modal with three tabs: summary, traffic sample, simulated metrics. Also a checkbox for "require telemetry gate" and an override flow that records a strong justification and notifies on-call.
Marta: For short-term mitigation: can we add a default safeguard that prevents any routing/cohort change from flipping >25% of routes in one apply? That would have blocked this.
Alex: Yes, policy suggestion: max_route_delta_pct per apply + require staged cohorts if > X%. Default max_route_delta_pct = 10.
Samir: API additions: POST /configs/preview (req: config, optional sample_window) -> returns simulated metric deltas and list of affected routes. POST /configs/apply should accept fields: owner, reason, require_telemetry_gate: bool, max_route_delta_pct: int.
Marta: Example apply command for ops teams:
```
runtimectl apply --id cfg_v2 --owner marta --reason "perf tuning" --require-telemetry-gate true
```
Alex: Telemetry to watch for gate: inference.latency.p50/p95, routing.error_rate, routing.retries, config.apply.failures, kvcache.hit_rate. Make them first-class in the gate schema.
Samir: We'll need infra work: 1) a sandboxed replay service that can consume a trace and run the runtime config variant, 2) quota to avoid charging customers during simulation, 3) dashboard widgets to show preview diffs and gating decisions.
Jess: UX followups: add a prominent warning when apply touches production routing for more than 5 routes; require a staged rollout option (cohort sizes: 1%, 10%, 100%) with automatic hold for the gate window.
Marta: I'll open an RFC for the gating + preview API and create a follow-up ticket to add the console modal mockups. For immediate hotfix, I reverted cfg_v2 and re-enabled the previous stable config.
Alex: Thanks — please paste the rollback command output in the ticket and tag infra on-call. Also, let's set an interim rule: all routing/cohort changes must go through preview for the next two weeks.
Marta: Will do. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
